title: Stalkwise regular closed immersions of constant codimension, including zero
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $c\in\mathbb N$. Define $i$ to be stalkwise regular of codimension $c$ if for every $z\in Z$ the kernel of $\mathcal O_{X,i(z)}\to\mathcal O_{Z,z}$ is generated by an $\mathcal O_{X,i(z)}$-regular sequence of length $c$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. On Noetherian schemes this is the regular closed immersion of constant codimension $c$. The empty source is permitted and for $c=0$ this includes every open-and-closed immersion.
